summary: Da lap bang danh gia chinh thuc RAG-V2 vs Letta vs Zep vs Mem0, va chi ra cac layer/phu tro de ap dung ngay vao RAG-V2. Ket luan: khong thay RAG-V2 luc nay; hoc Zep ve context asse
detail: Da lap bang danh gia chinh thuc RAG-V2 vs Letta vs Zep vs Mem0, va chi ra cac layer/phu tro de ap dung ngay vao RAG-V2. Ket luan: khong thay RAG-V2 luc nay; hoc Zep ve context assembly, Mem0 ve memory layer/trace/compression, Letta ve stateful agent design. Khuyen nghi uu tien nhat de cai thien chat luong la structured memory extraction + promotion, sau do la provenance va lightweight entity/relationship sidecar.
